### Approach and Rationale

We will use a genetic algorithm (GA) to search the space of non-negative sequences ast strategy. Genetic algorithms excel at exploration and escaping local minima through mutation and crossover. This approach differs from the previous one by not relying on direct optimization or structured descent but b using population-based exploration. The key idea is to maintain diversity in the sequence population through adaptive mutation and crossover rates, while selecting the best candidates for further optimization.

- \(0 \leq \text{value} \leq 1000\) (clamped via evaluator)
